extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants and patent attorneys/agents filing requests for accelerated examination under the Patent Prosecution Highway (PPH) at the Finnish Patent and Registration Office (PRH)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for preparing and filing a request for accelerated examination under the Patent Prosecution Highway (PPH) at the Finnish PRH, using either national work products or PCT international work products. Covers eligibility requirements, required documents, claim correspondence, translations, and procedural steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Same earliest date between PRH and OEE applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Both the PRH application on which the PPH is requested and the Office of Earlier Examination (OEE) application(s) forming the basis of the PPH request shall have the same earliest date (whether this be a priority date or a filing date).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include: (i) PRH application claims priority from the OEE application; (ii) PRH application provides the basis of a valid priority claim for the OEE application; (iii) PRH and OEE share a common priority document; (iv) PCT national phase applications derived from a common PCT international application having no priority claim. See Annex figures A–N for family-relationship examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presence of at least one corresponding OEE application with patentable/allowable claim(s)
rubrics_metrics.description: At least one corresponding application must exist in the OEE and have one or more claims that are determined to be patentable/allowable by the OEE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Claims clearly identified to be patentable in the latest office action at examination stage can form the basis for a PPH request even if the OEE application has not yet been granted. Provide copies of the relevant office actions (see required documents).

rubrics_metrics.name: All PRH claims must sufficiently correspond to OEE allowable claims
rubrics_metrics.description: All claims in the PRH application (for which accelerated examination is requested) must sufficiently correspond to one or more of those claims determined to be patentable/allowable in the OEE application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ‘Sufficiently correspond’ means, accounting for differences due to translations and claim format, the PRH claims are of the same or similar scope as the OEE claims, or are narrower in scope. A claim is narrower if an OEE claim is amended to be further limited by an additional feature supported in the specification. Introducing a new/different category of claim (e.g., adding product claims where the OEE only had process claims) is not sufficient correspondence. Claims amended or added after grant of the PPH request need not correspond.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRH application must not have a Communication of Acceptance already issued
rubrics_metrics.description: The PRH must not yet have issued a 'Communication of Acceptance' ('Hyväksyvä välipäätös') for the PRH application at the time of filing the PPH request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a Communication of Acceptance has been issued, the application is not eligible to enter PPH under that PRH application file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copy of OEE office actions and translations
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a copy of office actions (relevant to patentability) in the corresponding OEE application(s), and translations of them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Office actions are substantive examination documents sent by the OEE examiner. Applicant may supply them with the request or ask PRH to retrieve them from the OEE database. Translations into Finnish or English are acceptable; machine translations are admissible but the examiner can request resubmission if the translation is insufficient for understanding the outline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copy of claims found patentable/allowable by OEE and translations
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide copies of the claims found to be patentable/allowable by the OEE and translations of them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicant may supply them or request PRH to obtain them from the OEE's database. Finnish and English translations acceptable. Machine translation guidance as for office actions applies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete claim correspondence table
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit a complete claim correspondence table showing the relationship between the claims of the PRH application and the claims of the corresponding OEE application considered patentable/allowable by the OEE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If claims are literal translations, writing 'they are same' in the table is sufficient. If not literal translations, the applicant must explain the sufficient correspondence of each claim based on the 'sufficiently correspond' criteria. The claim correspondence table must be in Finnish or English.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copies of references cited by the OEE examiner
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit copies of the references cited by the OEE examiner in support of their examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Patent documents typically need not be submitted as PRH can usually access them; if PRH lacks access, applicant must submit them on request. Non-patent literature must always be submitted. Translations of cited references are unnecessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incorporation by reference of previously submitted documents
rubrics_metrics.description: If the applicant has already submitted required documents to PRH through simultaneous or past procedures, those documents may be incorporated by reference and need not be re-attached.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate clearly which documents are incorporated by reference on the PPH request form; PRH will retrieve them from the file-wrapper where available.

rubrics_metrics.name: PPH request filing procedure and PPH Administrator review
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant fills out the PRH PPH request form and attaches all relevant supporting documents; the PPH Administrator (a PRH patent examiner) will consider the request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If requirements are not met, the PPH Administrator will notify the applicant, explain why entry was denied, and the applicant may correct deficiencies and re-request acceleration until PRH issues a Communication of Acceptance. If allowed entry, PRH notifies the examining group and the application receives accelerated examination. If denied, the application awaits action in the regular queue.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCT-PPH: latest international work product must indicate patentable/allowable claim(s)
rubrics_metrics.description: For PCT-PPH requests, the latest work product in the international phase (WO/ISA, WO/IPEA, or IPER) corresponding to the application must indicate that at least one claim is patentable/allowable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An International Search Report (ISR) alone cannot be the basis for a PCT-PPH request. If any observation is described in Box VIII of WO/ISA, WO/IPEA or IPER that forms the basis of the PCT-PPH request, the applicant must explain why the claim(s) are not subject to that observation. Failure to provide an explanation renders the application ineligible for PCT-PPH (the adequacy of the explanation need not be judged for eligibility).

rubrics_metrics.name: PCT-PPH: acceptable family-relationship between PRH and international application
rubrics_metrics.description: The PRH application must satisfy one of the specified relationships to the corresponding international application (e.g., national phase of the international application, national application as basis of priority claim, national phase claiming priority from corresponding international, national application claiming priority from corresponding international, or derivative/divisional application of the foregoing).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Annex 2 for illustrative figures A–E1/E2 describing acceptable relationship scenarios. The ISA/IPEA that produced the international work product must be one listed in Appendix A for PCT-PPH eligibility, though priority claim references can point to any office.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCT-PPH: PRH claims must sufficiently correspond to claims indicated patentable/allowable in international work product
rubrics_metrics.description: All claims, as originally filed or amended, for examination under PCT-PPH must sufficiently correspond to one or more of those claims indicated to be patentable/allowable in the latest international work product of the corresponding international application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Same 'sufficiently correspond' definition as national PPH: same/similar scope or narrower (narrower means further limited by an additional feature supported in the specification). Introducing a new/different category of claims is not sufficient. Claims amended or added after grant of the PCT-PPH request need not correspond.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCT-PPH: copy of latest international work product and translations
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a copy of the latest international work product (WO/ISA, WO/IPEA or IPER) that indicated the claims to be patentable/allowable, with Finnish or English translations if not in English.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the application is a national phase application satisfying certain relationships, the IPRP may already be in the file-wrapper and need not be submitted. If the documents are available via PATENTSCOPE, submission is not required unless PRH requests them. WO/ISA/W O/IPEA/IPER availability timing is noted (e.g., IPRP chapters usually available ~30 months after priority). Machine translations into Finnish or English are admissible but examiner can request resubmission if incomprehensible.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCT-PPH: copy of set of claims indicated patentable/allowable and translations
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a copy of the set of claims which the latest international work product indicated to be patentable/allowable, with Finnish or English translations if not in English.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the claims are available via PATENTSCOPE or in the published international Patent Gazette, submission is not required unless requested by PRH. Machine translation guidance applies.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCT-PPH: copies of references cited in the international work product
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit copies of references cited in the latest international work product of the corresponding international application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Patent documents generally need not be submitted if PRH can access them; PRH may request them if not accessible. Non-patent literature must always be submitted. Translations of cited references are unnecessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCT-PPH: claim correspondence table requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a complete claim correspondence table showing the relationship between the PRH application claims and the claims indicated to be patentable/allowable in the latest international work product.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the claims are literal translations, writing 'They are the same' is sufficient. If not literal translations, the applicant must explain the sufficient correspondence of each claim per the PCT-PPH 'sufficiently correspond' criteria. The table must be in Finnish or English.
